source: RSD commit stage ports (cmStage.commit[i] + cmStage.alReadData[i]) sampled from rsd.vcd by tools/rsd/rsd_commits.py; insn joined from debugIF.idReg[i] by OpId; not from a pipeline tracker
cycleRule: cycle k = [posedge_k, posedge_{k+1}) of TOP.clk_p, k 0-based from the first posedge in this VCD; values sampled just before posedge_{k+1}; a commit is a cycle where commit[i]==1 (slot 0 is older than slot 1)
order: RSD has no order tag: order = 0-based commit sequence number within this VCD

kanata.rule: Kanata cycles are absolute (counted from the C= line). A stage cell in Kanata cycle K is VCD cycle K - cycleOffset (the op enters Cm in Kanata cycle vcdCommitCycle + cycleOffset); the R (retire) line is written one Kanata cycle later, at vcdCommitCycle + retireLineOffset
